Wen Gujiang half-opened her eyes, her vision blurred by tears, so she couldn't tell what time it was. So, Song Lili was very polite to this manager, not like some artists from the three major entertainment companies who accept performances or projects invested by their own companies. When it comes to film and television dramas, the company will strongly suppress the film remuneration and advertising fees. Cai Jing is negotiating with a military doctor, and beside him there are two government servants carrying a stretcher, and on the stretcher lies Du Feilong, who is covered in blood. Although the clothes she is wearing are still the same ones, they have been appropriately modified, and the style does not seem to have been significantly changed. They all used their own craftsmanship and asked Liu Xinyu to help them make new clothes. When Qin Xiao heard the news, he immediately got excited and called Zhao Shangwu. This kind of thing still had to rely on Zhao Shangwu's experience. Compared with other people, these guards who lived in the Duke's Mansion knew Ye Feng in detail. They sensed the aura on his body and found that it was not powerful. It was probably a third-level spiritual beast, equivalent to the strength of a human saint.
